gates.name: Source, database, browser, and security CI
gates.criterion: Main passes checks, PostgreSQL isolation, browser coverage, dependency review, secret scanning, SBOM generation, and CodeQL.
gates.nextAction: Merge the browser-smoke locator fix through a reviewed pull request, require CI, Security, and Production-path smoke to pass on the resulting main commit, then replace this evidence and mark the gate complete.

gates.name: Local production-path smoke
gates.criterion: The containerized production profile passes media, observability, multi-writer, backup/restore, restart, and 100-client correctness checks.

gates.name: Canadian staging deployment
gates.criterion: A TLS-only Canadian deployment passes configuration preflight and the remote readiness workflow with PostgreSQL, Redis, SMTP, object storage, metrics, and tracing enabled.
gates.nextAction: Provision the canada-staging GitHub environment and run Staging readiness.

gates.name: Monitoring and paging delivery
gates.criterion: Production telemetry reaches the selected backend and test page, warning, and ticket alerts reach named responders.
gates.nextAction: Install the collector and Alertmanager templates, configure secret receiver URLs, then record a notification drill.

gates.name: Target-region load and soak
gates.criterion: Canadian staging passes the 100-client latency gate and a representative soak from the self-hosted canada-staging runner without correctness or reconciliation loss.
gates.nextAction: Bring an isolated runner online in the Canadian target region with the canada-staging label, run Staging readiness at 100 clients, and attach the load and soak record.

gates.name: Managed backup and restore drill
gates.criterion: A managed PostgreSQL backup and private object-storage restore is timed and verified against the stated RPO and RTO.
gates.nextAction: Complete the provider drill using the restoration evidence template.

gates.name: Manual accessibility review
gates.criterion: Keyboard, VoiceOver, NVDA, 200% zoom, contrast, reduced-motion, and extended-time scenarios are reviewed with no unresolved launch blockers.
gates.nextAction: Run the manual matrix and link the signed review record.

gates.name: Independent security review
gates.criterion: An independent review covers authentication, realtime authorization, replay, XSS, uploads, rate limits, billing, administration, and infrastructure with no open critical or high findings.
gates.nextAction: Schedule the review and record findings and remediation in the security evidence template.

gates.name: Canadian privacy and legal approval
gates.criterion: Qualified counsel approves the privacy notice, terms, consent, retention, deletion, data residency, subprocessors, and paid-beta posture.
gates.nextAction: Provide the data map and launch documents to Canadian counsel and link written approval.

gates.name: Live billing rehearsal
gates.criterion: Stripe test mode proves checkout, portal, signed webhook delivery, retry idempotency, cancellation, and entitlement reconciliation in Canadian staging.
gates.nextAction: Run the signed replay workflow, then complete a provider-originated Stripe test-mode purchase and cancellation.

gates.name: Protected release governance
gates.criterion: Main requires passing CI and security checks, review, conversation resolution, and blocks force pushes and deletion.
gates.nextAction: Add a second human reviewer, activate the prepared ruleset, pass a normally reviewed canary PR without bypass, and record the ruleset insight.

gates.name: Physical-device and network matrix
gates.criterion: Supported mobile and desktop devices complete QR join, play, reconnect, and report flows on representative Wi-Fi and cellular networks.
gates.nextAction: Execute the device evidence template against Canadian staging.

gates.name: Design partners and observed sessions
gates.criterion: At least three education and three workplace partners are recruited and at least ten beta sessions are observed with reconciled reports.
gates.nextAction: Recruit named partners and store redacted interview and session records.

gates.name: P0 beta usability success metrics
gates.criterion: Representative first-time facilitators and participants meet every P0 creation, live-action comprehension, response, receipt, results-discovery, report-comprehension, and Recovery Rehearsal threshold in an accepted usability study.
gates.nextAction: Run the moderated beta usability protocol and have product research approve a completed usability evidence record.

gates.name: Signed community release candidate
gates.criterion: A v0.9.0 release candidate publishes signed OCI images, provenance, SBOMs, scan results, Compose documentation, and upgrade and rollback guidance.
gates.nextAction: After every Canadian beta preflight gate is complete, create a signed v0.9.0 tag from main and retain the release workflow evidence.
